title: Turn images into video with Wan 2.6
summary:
Image-to-video, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and a larger Klein model joined the lineup, while Flux gained canvas room and model health stats got clearer.

Alibaba Wan 2.6 was added as `wan`. It turns an input image into 720P video lasting 2–15 seconds, with auto-dubbed audio on by default and an option to turn it off. Usage reporting now separates audio seconds from video usage; the shared usage headers no longer include `x-usage-total-tokens`.

Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro was added as `gemini-legacy`, with a 1M-token context window, multimodal input, reasoning, tools, search, and code execution.

`klein-large` adds the 9B FLUX.2 Klein model for image generation and reference-image editing under a non-commercial license. Flux also accepts up to 1024×1024 total pixels, up from 768×768, and rejects out-of-range dimensions with HTTP 400.

highlights.title: Images become Wan videos
highlights.text: Send an image to `wan` for a 720P video lasting 2–15 seconds. Auto-dubbed audio is on by default; set `audio=false` to leave it out. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=wan).

highlights.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro added
highlights.text: Use `gemini-legacy` for a 1M-token context window, multimodal input, reasoning, tools, search, and code execution. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-legacy).

highlights.title: Klein gets a 9B variant
highlights.text: Generate or edit images with reference images using `klein-large`, the FLUX.2 Klein 9B variant. It carries a non-commercial license. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=klein-large).

highlights.title: Larger Flux image canvases
highlights.text: Flux now accepts up to 1024×1024 total pixels, up from 768×768, giving image prompts more room to work. [Explore image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
